```{r}
#| label: setup-multilevel
#| include: false
# The saved outputs of the scripts that ran once on the licensed respondent
# file (companion/_model-outputs/: fit_models.R, fit_person_multilevel.R,
# fit_person_years.R, fit_person_anchor.R, and the refits of
# R/eu-frames/13_reference_marks.R), with the panel beside them. Nothing
# person-level is read. Comes after the setup chunk of the case, whose
# analysts5 it uses.
panel <- readr::read_csv("../cases/eu-frames/data/EUframes_cy.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
real_ml <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/person_multilevel_real.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
anchor <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/anchor_person_fixed.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
grad <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/prevalence_gradient.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
refits <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/reference_refits.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
years_real <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/person_year_effects.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)
cosmo_dist <- readr::read_csv("../companion/_model-outputs/cosmo_dist.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

# The unemployment slope under the three random structures, and the standard
# deviations of the variance components, on the real respondents
real_unemp <- datawizard::data_filter(real_ml, kind == "fixed", term == "unemp")
real_sd <- datawizard::data_filter(real_ml, kind == "random")
sd_three <- datawizard::data_filter(real_sd, model == "three_level")
var_three <- sd_three$value^2
share_groups <- sum(var_three[sd_three$term != "Residual: NA"]) / sum(var_three)

# The random-intercept model of the panel, set beside the models of the
# respondents
m_panel_ri <- lmerTest::lmer(mcosmo ~ unemp + (1 | cntry), data = panel)
panel_ri <- summary(m_panel_ri)$coefficients["unemp", ]

# The two analysts who worked at the level of the respondents
kevf1 <- datawizard::data_filter(analysts5, analyst_id == "KEVF1")
prl47 <- datawizard::data_filter(analysts5, analyst_id == "PRL47")

# The arithmetic of composition with the coefficients of the real respondents:
# the published design without its interactions, with country-waves as the
# middle level (anchor_person_fixed.csv), and the prevalence gradient within
# country and year
b_ind <- anchor$estimate[anchor$outcome == "cosmo" & anchor$term == "sesunemployed"]
b_ctx <- anchor$estimate[anchor$outcome == "cosmo" & anchor$term == "munemp"]
grad_w <- grad$gradient[2]

# The refits of the published design, with and without its interactions
oa_published <- datawizard::data_filter(refits, refit_id == "OA_published")
oa_no_interactions <- datawizard::data_filter(refits, refit_id == "OA_no_interactions")

# The two-way design of the panel with growth as an adjustment, beside the
# published design on the respondents with and without terms for the years
agg_cosmo <- lm(mcosmo ~ unemp + growth + factor(year) + factor(cntry), data = panel)
agg_lib <- lm(mlib ~ unemp + growth + factor(year) + factor(cntry), data = panel)
designs <- dplyr::bind_rows(
  tibble::tibble(outcome = c("cosmo", "lib"), design = "two_way",
                 estimate = c(coef(agg_cosmo)[["unemp"]], coef(agg_lib)[["unemp"]]),
                 t = c(summary(agg_cosmo)$coefficients["unemp", "t value"],
                       summary(agg_lib)$coefficients["unemp", "t value"])),
  years_real |>
    datawizard::data_filter(kind == "fixed", term == "munemp") |>
    datawizard::data_select(c("outcome", "design", "estimate", "t"))
)
n_complete <- years_real$estimate[years_real$kind == "n" & years_real$design == "published" &
                                    years_real$outcome == "cosmo"]
```
